chapterInfo.content:
13
Adiyifoɔ atorofoɔ ho atemmusɛm
1Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: 2Onipa ba, hyɛ Israel adiyifoɔ a wɔhyɛ nkɔm no ho nkɔm, na ka kyerɛ wɔn a wɔfiri wɔn ara wɔn tirim hyɛ nkɔm no sɛ: Montie AWURADE asɛm. 3#Yer 23.21 Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Wɔnnue, adiyifoɔ nkwaseafoɔ a wɔdi wɔn honhom akyire na wɔnhunu hwee no. 4Israel, w’adiyifoɔ ayɛ sɛ akurofo mu nsakraman. 5#Hes 22.30 Momforo nkɔgyinaa ntokuro no mu, na monnyee Israel fie ho ban, sɛ mobɛgyina akono, AWURADE da no. 6#Hes 22.28; Yer 23.32 Ahuhudeɛ ne atorɔ nkɔmhyɛ na wɔn a wɔka sɛ: AWURADE asɛm nie, no hunu, nso na AWURADE nsomaa wɔn, nanso wɔtwɛn sɛ ɔbɛma wɔn asɛm no aba mu. 7Ɛnyɛ ahuhudeɛ na mohunu na atorɔ nkɔm na mohyɛ, sɛ moka sɛ: AWURADE asɛm nie, wɔ berɛ a menkasaeɛ?
8Ɛno nti, sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Ɛnam sɛ moka ahuhusɛm na mohunu atorɔ anisoadeɛ yi nti, hwɛ, me ne mo anya, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie. 9#Hes 14.9 Na me nsa bɛba adiyifoɔ a wɔhunu ahuhudeɛ na wɔhyɛ nkɔntorɔ no so: Wɔrentena me man badwa no mu, na wɔrentwerɛ wɔn din Israel fie edintwerɛ no mu, na wɔremma Israel asase so, na moahunu sɛ mene AWURADE Nyankopɔn. 10#Yer 6.14 Ɛfiri sɛ, aane ɛfiri sɛ wɔsisi me man ka sɛ: Asomdwoeɛ, na asomdwoeɛ nni hɔ, na ɔman no to fasuo bi, na hwɛ, wɔn deɛ, wɔde hyire sra ho nti, 11ka kyerɛ wɔn a wɔde hyire sra ho no sɛ: Ɛbɛhwe ase! Osuo a ɛsram soɔ bɛba, na asukɔtweaa bɛtotɔ, na kyinhyia mframa bɛbɔ. 12Na hwɛ, ɔfasuo no bɛhwe ase. Wɔrenka nkyerɛ mo sɛ: Ɛhe na sra a mosraa ho no wɔ? 13Ɛno nti, sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Mɛma kyinhyia mframa abɔ wɔ m’abufuhyeɛ mu, na osuo a ɛsram soɔ aba wɔ m’abufuo mu, na asukɔtweaa aba anibereɛ mu abɛwie. 14Na mɛdwiri fasuo a mode akaadoo kaa ho no agu ama no aka fam, na ne nnyinasoɔ ada adi, na ahwe ase, na moadwerɛ wɔ mu, na moahunu sɛ, mene AWURADE. 15Na mɛwie m’abufuhyeɛ, ɔfasuo ne wɔn a wɔde hyire sraa ho no so, na maka akyerɛ mo sɛ: Ɔfasuo no nni hɔ bio, na wɔn a wɔsraa ho no nso nni hɔ bio, 16#Hes 13.10 Israel adiyifoɔ a wɔkaa Yerusalem ho adiyisɛm, sɛ wɔhunuu asomdwoeɛ adeɛ maa no, nanso asomdwoeɛ biara nni hɔ no, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie.
17Na wo, onipa ba yi w’ani sa wo man mmaa a wɔfiri wɔn adwene mu hyehyɛ nkɔm no, na hyɛ wɔn ho nkɔm sɛ: 18Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Monnue, mo mmaa a mopempam nkataho ma nsa akwaa nyinaa, na mopam nnuku ma etire ahodoɔ nyinaa, sɛ mode reyi akra. Moyi me man akra, na mo ara mo kra deɛ, mogye no nkwa? 19#Yer 5.23; Mmb 17.15 Na mogu me ho fi, me man mu, atokoɔ nsa ma ma ne paanoo afono ma bi nti, sɛ mode atorɔ a modi kyerɛ me man a wɔtie atorɔ no rekum akra a ɛnni kum, na moregye akra a wɔnnsɛ nkwa no nkwa.
20Ɛno nti, sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Hwɛ, me ne nkaberɛ a mode reyi akra sɛ nnomaa no anya, na mɛtete afiri mo basa ho, na magyaa akra no, akra a moyi wɔn no, ama wɔatutu akɔ sɛ nnomaa. 21Na mɛtete mo nnuku, na mayi me man afiri mo nsa mu, na wɔantena mo nsa mu sɛ ahayɛdeɛ bio, na moahunu sɛ mene AWURADE. 22#Yer 23.14 Ɛsiane sɛ mode atorɔ ma ɔteneneeni a, me deɛ, menhyɛ no awerɛhoɔ no akoma tutuo, na mohyɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ nsa mu den, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na wansane amfiri ne kwammɔne so na wannnya nkwa nti, 23morenhunu anisoadeɛ huhuo bio, na nkɔm nso morenhyɛ bio; na mɛyi me man afiri mo nsa mu, na moahunu sɛ mene AWURADE.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
